title: Inexact Warped Resolvent iterations
summary: In this paper we aim to solve structured monotone inclusions using inexact warped resolvents evaluated under a relative-error criterion. The resulting algorithms admit a geometric interpretation as relaxed projection methods onto dynamically generated cuts, extending classical projection--proximal and hybrid extragradient proximal frameworks to nonlinear warped resolvent. Under mild assumptions, we establish weak convergence of the iterates.
